simple.meaning: אַחְיוֹ (ʼAchyôw) is a Hebrew word meaning “Achio , the name of three Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: Achio , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H283. Achyo אַחְיוֺ proper name, masculine (= אחיון , i.e. fraternal ). 1 a son of Aminadab, brother of Uzzah 2Sam 6:3-4 , ( אֶחָיו ᵐ5 , We אָחִיו , but see Dr) 1Chr 13:7 ( אֶחָיו ᵐ5 ). 2 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:14 , but read ᵐ5 אָחִיו Be. 3 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:31 = 9:37 (> אֶחָיו ᵐ5 ).

occurrences.englishText: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
They brought it out of Abinadab’s house, which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.
They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
